_: OCM data providers whose records may enter charging.sqlite (wedrive-charging/1).
allow: published with this licence on their own `source` row. The licence text is OCM's
referencedata DataProviders[].License, copied 2026-11-21; `licence` is our short name for it.
excluded: known providers without an open licence; their records are dropped and counted.
A provider id in NEITHER list is dropped and reported as a warning (an issue, not a failure):
a new id joins `allow` only after the owner has reviewed its licence.
26 Oplaadpalen.nl (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0) is included by the owner's decision of 2026-11-21:
one personal, non-commercial vehicle; its licence travels on its row.
